description: The `graph_schema` value the TypeScript SDK's createGraphCollection sends in POST /collections for each schemaMode. velesdb-server deserializes it as velesdb_core::GraphSchema (crates/velesdb-server/src/handlers/collections.rs, parse_graph_schema); crates/velesdb-core/tests/graph_schema_wire_conformance.rs proves each case does and yields the stated mode, sdks/typescript/tests/graph-backend.test.ts that the SDK sends exactly these values.
